webster.text: Having great multiplicity; having great diversity or variety; as multifarious artifice.

example.quote: Thus, for the want of a navy, are we deprived of the multifarious advantages of our natural situation ; nor is it possible that,
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
